test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

James Bernard was undoubtedly one of the greatest elocutionists of the world. Everyone agreed that he possessed the ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is Gift of the gab.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's check meaning of each option-

 
 
• Yellow press- **Newspapers which publish sensationalist articles** rather than well researched and sober journalism.
 
• Fourth estate- **Newspapers, magazines, television, and radio stations and the people who work for them **who are thought to have a lot of political influence.
 
• Curtain lecture- A **private scolding or lecture by a wife** to her husband.
 
• *Gift of the gab- The **ability to speak easily** and **confidently** in a way that makes people want to listen to you and believe you.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill the gap is 'gift of the gab'.
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

**Correct Sentence**: *James Bernard was undoubtedly one of the greatest elocutionists of the world. Everyone agreed that he possessed the gift of the gab.*
